04919 M@shillemowth {mesh-il-lay-mohth'}

源自 07999; 複數陽性專有名詞

AV - Meshillemoth 2; 2

米實利末 = "回報"

1) 一名以法蓮人 (#代下 28:12|)
2) 一名祭司, 音麥的兒子 (#尼 11:13|)
   2a) 亦作 '米實利密'
record.edic_text:
04919 M@shillemowth {mesh-il-lay-mohth'}

from 07999;; n pr m pl

AV - Meshillemoth 2; 2

Meshillemoth = "recompense"
1) an Ephraimite, one of the chiefs of the tribe in the reign of king
   Pekah of Israel
   1a) also 'Meshillemith'
2) a priest, son of Immer
   2a) also 'Meshillemith'
